title: FyreVariants
description: Adds variants to existing Minecraft blocks
body:
**FyreVariants** adds variants to existing Minecraft blocks & items  
Everything stays vanilla friendly. Just more choices for people to use.

[Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph) _Recommended due to rail recipes using sticks which have no variants_

---

## Added Variants

**Wood Types:**  
Acacia · Bamboo · Birch · Cherry · Crimson · Dark Oak · Jungle · Mangrove · Oak · Spruce · Warped

**Minecart Types:**  
Iron · Copper · Gold · Diamond · Netherite

**Blocks & Items:**
- **Barrels**
- **Chests**
- **Composters**
- **Crafting Tables**
- **Ladders**
- **Rails**
- **Campfires**
- **Beehives**
- **Minecarts**
- **Lecterns**
- **Fletching Tables**
- **Cartography Tables**

---

## Community & Support

Have feedback, ideas, or found a bug?

- No plans to port to other Minecraft versions (for now)

Thanks for checking out **FyreVariants**!
